description:
Hear ye, hear ye! We are Astrobyte, a group of software engineering and computer science students with a love for wonderful storytelling in science. 

Today we have created DoppelGrund, a search engine that aids space mission teams find new analog sites used as training grounds on Earth. It identifies never-before-seen locations using NASA data, scoring Earth against Moon and Mars targets in real measured units, and showing exactly where each match falls short
